A '''Pressurized Fuel Chamber''' was a component of [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projectors]] such as [[Flame Carbine]]s and [[Flame Rifle]]s. On a [[carbine]], the Pressurized Fuel Chamber was connected to the weapon's [[Force-Feed Air Intake]]. On the [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]], the Pressurized Fuel Chamber was located as part of the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], situated behind the [[Discharge Nozzle]].<ref name="EGWT" />
